nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$, $t \in G$, and $\psi$ an additive character of $G$ with values in $\mathbb{C}$, and write $\hat h(\psi) = \sum_{x \in G} \psi(x) h(x)$ for the discrete Fourier transform of $h : G \to \mathbb{C}$. If $g(x) = f(x - t)$ for all $x \in G$, then $\hat g(\psi) = \psi(t) \hat f(\psi)$.
nodes.title: Translation modulates the discrete Fourier transform

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group and $f : G \to \mathbb{C}$. The discrete Fourier transform of $f$ is the function on the additive characters $\psi$ of $G$ with values in $\mathbb{C}$ (maps with $\psi(0) = 1$ and $\psi(a + b) = \psi(a)\psi(b)$) given by $\hat f(\psi) = \sum_{x \in G} \psi(x) f(x)$.
